verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same. In both, the beige circle has moved inward and floats as a large cropped disc, where in the original it was a corner bleed. Both also leave a dead band above the quote mark, and the logo row sits detached in the lower left. A has a slight edge because its quote, attribution, logo and can are spread more evenly down the page; B pushes them all upward, which leaves more empty space below the can and the logo.
